# FLX-3706: a calibration parameter names a document or a number the bundle does not have

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Each parameter of the calibration block names a document by its file name, one of the FLUX documents of the bundle's closed set (ADR 0006), and a JSON Pointer to one number the parameter register lists in it. A file outside that set, a file that holds more than one document, a pointer that reaches no number the register counts, a value outside the parameter's min and max, a step with no value between them, or two parameters that name the same number is refused, and the message says which. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3706
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
